title: Revert "aync_status rewrite (#74577)"
body:
##### SUMMARY

Temporarily reverting #74577 until issues with the changes are resolved.

This reverts commit b6de1984db13312ce7520cd6660cd0aaf9266ac2.

cc @bcoca

##### ISSUE TYPE

Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME

lib/ansible/modules/async_status.py

##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

The nightly coverage runs failed: https://dev.azure.com/ansible/ansible/_build/results?buildId=16184&view=logs&j=9807042f-8745-560e-2f21-6b916c1a99a5&t=f97200d8-cd63-5896-5498-e72411f6d3c6&l=2187

```
02:27 TASK [async : get async status with custom dir - deprecated format] ************
...
02:27 fatal: [testhost]: FAILED! => {
02:27     "changed": false,
02:27     "msg": "could not find job"
02:27 }
```

I was able to reproduce locally with: `ansible-test integration async --coverage --docker fedora34 -v`

Running without `--coverage` passed, which is probably why the original PR passed CI.
